verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents upsert or delete operations, how quickly writes show up in query results, or any freshness or consistency guarantees. The automatic-indexing claim and a community mention of SPFresh indexes are related, but they do not show continuous mutation with documented freshness behavior. A vector database can reasonably offer this, so the story applies and the absence of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upsert and delete records continuously and have changes reflected in search results quickly, with documented freshness/consistency behavior
